summary: Culver's announced a brand-wide deployment of Berry AI's vision-AI platform across its full network of 1,000+ restaurant locations.
Berry AI provides camera-based vision-AI systems tracking drive-thru, dining room and kiosk speed-of-service and throughput, describing itself as the most widely deployed vision-AI solution in QSR.

Berry AI reports partner deployments showing up to 70% improvement in drive-thru comps, 20-40% reductions in drive-thru service time, and up to 20% improvement in throughput. (Scope note: ROI ranges are vendor-reported aggregate claims across partner deployments, not independently audited or attributed to a single named customer.)
